title: Distribution operations
subtitle: 4 depot managers. Daily check-ins. Each problem is written down once, then followed up.
updated: Last updated on Wednesday 23 September at 6pm. The board only changes when something new comes in, such as a check-in, a report, a decision or a number from another system.
question: Dispatch on time, every day, safely?
headline: 95.8% of orders left on time this month. The target is 98%
under: 3 of this month’s 4 big problems had a cause we have seen before. Fixing the forklift in Mombasa would close most of the gap on its own.
